p592e8fcf.text: DESPITE THE GLOBAL WARMING, ENGLAND IS STILL NOT WARM ENOUGH FOR HIM.
p592e8fcf.speaker: Arsene Wenger
p592e8fcf.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
p592e8fcf.reveal: Comment on Jose Antonio Reyes wanting to leave Arsenal, July 2007 (referenced from 2006/07 season).

p66f7906f.text: THIERRY HENRY IS PROBABLY TECHNICALLY THE MOST GIFTED FOOTBALLER EVER TO PLAY THE BEAUTIFUL GAME.
p66f7906f.speaker: Arsene Wenger
p66f7906f.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
p66f7906f.reveal: Wenger's tribute to Henry near the end of his Arsenal career, mid-2000s.

p059e463f.text: I THINK I AM THE BEST PLAYER IN THE WORLD. I'M NOT AFRAID TO SAY IT.
p059e463f.speaker: Cristiano Ronaldo
p059e463f.prompt: A player in the Premier League said this
p059e463f.reveal: Comments during his rise at Manchester United, mid-2000s.

p7bda3422.text: ONLY TRUE CHAMPIONS COME OUT AND SHOW THEIR WORTH AFTER DEFEAT, AND I EXPECT US TO DO THAT.
p7bda3422.speaker: Sir Alex Ferguson
p7bda3422.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
p7bda3422.reveal: After Manchester United's defeat to Arsenal, 2006.

p9bc7505d.text: ARSENAL IS IN MY BLOOD AS WELL AS MY HEART. I WILL ALWAYS, ALWAYS, ALWAYS REMEMBER YOU GUYS.
p9bc7505d.speaker: Thierry Henry
p9bc7505d.prompt: A player in the Premier League said this
p9bc7505d.reveal: Comments upon leaving Arsenal for Barcelona, 2007 (referenced from his farewell period, 2006/07 season).

pc8aefff1.text: I'M OBSESSED BY THE IDEA OF MAKING MY MARK ON HISTORY. AND ARSENAL IS MY PARADISE.
pc8aefff1.speaker: Thierry Henry
pc8aefff1.prompt: A player in the Premier League said this
pc8aefff1.reveal: Reflection during his prime years at Arsenal, mid-2000s.

p327c62c7.text: I'M READY TO TAKE THE BLAME FOR ALL THE PROBLEMS OF ENGLISH FOOTBALL IF THAT IS WHAT HE WANTS.
p327c62c7.speaker: Arsene Wenger
p327c62c7.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
p327c62c7.reveal: Response to Ferguson's comments about lack of homegrown players at Arsenal, November 2007.

pb3fa2570.text: I TRIED TO WATCH THE TOTTENHAM MATCH ON TELEVISION IN MY HOTEL YESTERDAY, BUT I FELL ASLEEP.
pb3fa2570.speaker: Arsene Wenger
pb3fa2570.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
pb3fa2570.reveal: Wenger's dismissive quip about Arsenal's north London rivals, cited in retrospectives.

p5ba82265.text: I WANT TO BE REMEMBERED AS ONE OF THE GREATEST PLAYERS OF ALL TIME.
p5ba82265.speaker: Cristiano Ronaldo
p5ba82265.prompt: A player in the Premier League said this
p5ba82265.reveal: Reflection during his award-laden 2006/07 season at Manchester United.

pb3be15c2.text: BY THE LOOK OF HIM, HE MUST HAVE HEADED A LOT OF BALLS.
pb3be15c2.speaker: Harry Redknapp
pb3be15c2.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
pb3be15c2.reveal: Redknapp's quip about a rival manager, cited in Premier League quote compilations.

p4a2b6121.text: HE SPEAKS, SPEAKS, SPEAKS ABOUT CHELSEA... HE'S A VOYEUR.
p4a2b6121.speaker: Jose Mourinho
p4a2b6121.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
p4a2b6121.reveal: Mourinho's jibe at Arsene Wenger during his first Chelsea spell, referenced 2005-07.

p725294d3.text: THE BEST TEAM LOST. AFTER THEY SCORED, ONLY ONE TEAM PLAYED, THE OTHER ONE JUST DEFENDED FOR THE WHOLE GAME.
p725294d3.speaker: Jose Mourinho
p725294d3.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
p725294d3.reveal: Mourinho's controversial post-match remark during his first Chelsea spell, cited in Premier League quote compilations.

p39ef9179.text: I AM MORE THAN UNHAPPY. UNHAPPY IS A NICE WORD.
p39ef9179.speaker: Jose Mourinho
p39ef9179.prompt: A manager in the Premier League said this
p39ef9179.reveal: Reaction to Thierry Henry's quick free-kick controversy in a 2-2 draw at Highbury, cited retrospectively.
